item.title: ImprovTalk: Building a Mobile App That Teaches Charisma Through Improvisation
item.description: An iOS app that trains charisma, communication and rapport-building using improvisation drills — short, repeatable exercises rather than theory, because conversational skill is a motor skill, not knowledge.

item.title: How I Built an AI Crypto Trading Strategy with XGBoost
item.description: An AI crypto trading strategy that runs live on Binance across eight symbols. XGBoost turns dozens of indicators into a single probability, with trendline and breakout confirmation on a second timeframe and entries on the 1-minute interval.

item.title: Graduating From Barcelona School of Economics With Honours
item.description: Graduating with honours from Barcelona School of Economics after a year of combining an intensive master’s with freelance client work in an unfamiliar city.

item.title: Balancing Freelance Data Science With a Master's Degree Abroad
item.description: A year of simultaneously delivering client work and completing an intensive Data Science for Decision Making master’s abroad — the time management, the trade-offs, and the outcome.

item.title: Accepted to Barcelona School of Economics: Data Science for Decision Making
item.description: Starting the Data Science for Decision Making master’s at Barcelona School of Economics, a programme that integrates data science with economics rather than treating them separately.

item.title: Taking the GRE and IELTS to Study Data Science Abroad
item.description: Preparing for and sitting the GRE and IELTS as entry requirements for a data science master’s programme, alongside full-time freelance work.

item.title: Reaching Expert-Vetted Status on Upwork as a Data Scientist
item.description: Upwork’s Expert-Vetted status is limited to the top 1% of talent and awarded by an expert screening panel. Reaching it took four years, 100+ clients and 6,000+ hours.

item.title: How Much Maths Do You Actually Need for Data Science?
item.description: An honest answer to the most common question from people entering data science: how much maths is genuinely required, and which parts of it matter in practice.
